verdict.rationale: Sentry's developer docs state you can run all of Sentry on your own server for free, and that Sentry offers and maintains an official self-hosted setup. A community user reports running self-hosted Sentry for years as rock-solid, while others note heavy memory and container growth and significant maintenance effort for modern versions. Missing for 10: the official setup is described as minimal and aimed at simple use cases, there is no evidence that AI-native features like Seer or MCP work self-hosted, and the resource and maintenance burden is documented by users.
